meta.note: The asset the public /revenue route serves by default (dur=2h, capex=mid, cod=2028, scenario=base). Present so the reference is just another config rather than a parallel literal (discipline rule #4); a vitest asserts it reproduces the no-config engine output field-for-field. `cod=2028` on the public route means commissioning completes in 2028 and operating year 1 is 2029 — hence first_operating_year 2029.
